project: Monetary Policy Transmission Analytics Platform - Nigeria

mpr.name: Monetary Policy Rate
mpr.description: Official benchmark interest rate set by CBN Monetary Policy Committee
mpr.academic_reference: CBN Communiqués of Monetary Policy Committee Meetings

inflation.name: Headline Consumer Price Index Inflation
inflation.transformation: YoY percentage change from CPI index

exchange_rate.name: Official Exchange Rate (Naira per USD)
exchange_rate.description: NAFEX (Investors & Exporters Window) rate - market-determined rate
exchange_rate.role: Transmission channel (responds to MPR via interest parity)
exchange_rate.academic_reference: CBN Statistical Bulletin, Exchange Rate Section
exchange_rate.note: Pre-2017 data uses interbank rate; post-2017 uses I&E window

money_supply.name: Broad Money Supply (M2)
money_supply.description: M2 = Currency in Circulation + Demand Deposits + Savings & Time Deposits
money_supply.academic_reference: CBN Statistical Bulletin, Money & Credit Section

data_sources_priority.coverage: Interactive query system for all CBN data
data_sources_priority.reliability: High - same source as bulletin, more up-to-date
High - good for missing CBN data points

data_sources_priority.source: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

data_collection_notes.missing_data_strategy: Linear interpolation for isolated missing months; forward fill for end-of-sample
data_collection_notes.outlier_handling: Flag values >3 SD from mean; investigate against CBN policy events
data_collection_notes.seasonal_adjustment: Not applied - monthly data retains seasonal patterns for VAR
data_collection_notes.citation_format: Central Bank of Nigeria (2024). Statistical Bulletin. Abuja: CBN.

academic_justification.sample_period: 2010-2025 covers multiple MPR cycles, naira devaluation episodes (2015-2016, 2020, 2023), and inflation surge periods, providing sufficient variation for identification.
academic_justification.variable_selection: Four-variable VAR follows Sims (1980) parsimony principle while capturing key transmission channels: interest rate, exchange rate, and monetary aggregate effects on prices.
academic_justification.data_frequency: Monthly frequency balances transmission lag dynamics (policy takes 3-12 months to affect inflation) with sufficient observations for estimation (T=180).
